coverage_scope: Declared accessible historical metadata and name-search boundary; no global exhaustive research coverage claim.
replacement_rule: No replacement after the fixed metadata query and native admission screening. PASS_NATIVE and FAIL_NATIVE equally eligible.
selection_basis: Repository names only, checked against 80 frozen local historical exclusions and exact name searches in accessible current ROS canonical state and checkpoints. No prospective task identities, native source, test outcomes or winning methods inspected.
